implementation.summary: Bounded ACI now supports snapshot-bound line continuation reads and ordered chunked file transactions while retaining the existing literal path, symlink, size, verifier, and atomic-file safeguards.
implementation.transaction_storage: Controlled same-directory staging files owned by the live ACI transaction; finalize uses atomic os.replace and abort removes only that staging file.

previous_phase_regression.command: PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests/test_corrective_c1_results.py tests/test_corrective_c2_scheduler.py tests/test_corrective_c3_aci.py tests/test_logical_subagents_g11.py tests/test_bounded_aci_g6.py tests/test_memory_g2.py tests/test_repository_context_g4.py tests/test_hooks_g9.py tests/test_laplace_core_g1.py tests/test_zetsu_hotfix_lifecycle.py tests/test_release_v7.py

notes: Every read page revalidates the authorized literal path and full-content snapshot hash.
Continuation tokens cannot redirect to another path or snapshot and invalid tokens fail closed.
Chunk writes require explicit sequence, byte offset, chunk hash, bounded UTF-8 payload, and same-transaction identity.
Finalization rechecks the original target state before atomic replacement; dirty or externally changed content is never silently overwritten.
No shell, network, arbitrary append, symlink traversal, or forced deletion path was added.

remaining_scope: Memory schema compatibility remains C4 scope.
Repository parser contract remains C5 scope.
